entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: A powerful dangerous multifaceted purple gemstone created by the founders of the Makindi empire, revealed to be an ancient piece of Zendikar's soul.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Kor planeswalker who seeks the Core to stop Zendikar's Roil, using it to petrify Akiri and kill Zareth.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who theorizes about the Core and takes control of Nahiri's mind.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker who sees the Core as a threat, destroys the focal point and uses the Core's power to heal Zendikar.

entities.name: Ashaya
entities.description: Elemental ally of Nissa who takes the Core from Jace and gives it to her.

entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: Hired companion petrified and pushed over a cliff by Nahiri.

entities.name: Zareth San
entities.description: Hired companion killed by Nahiri using the Core.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane the Core affects, scarred by the Roil.

entities.name: Singing City
entities.description: Old Kor structure destroyed in the Core's discharge.

entities.name: Elementals
entities.description: Elementals that attack on behalf of Nissa and Zendikar.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: Chaotic upheaval of Zendikar that Nahiri wants to stop.

entities.name: Lithoform Blight
entities.description: Dark effect of the Core's power that withers plants into rigid matter.

events.summary: In the Skyclave of Akoum, Nahiri and Nissa find a key tile that points to the Murasa skyclave; Nahiri uses its power, killing an elemental, and Nissa breaks off their partnership.
events.quote: For this, Nissa broke up their partnership.

events.summary: In the Murasa skyclave Nahiri finds the Core, kills Zareth using it, and petrifies Akiri and pushes her over a cliff.
events.quote: Using the artifact to defend herself, Nahiri killed Zareth in the process.

events.summary: Jace promises not to hinder Nahiri if she does not use the Core until they have studied it.
events.quote: Jace Beleren promised to not hinder her in her endeavor to save Zendikar

events.summary: Nissa and her elementals have destroyed the focal point and attack Jace and Nahiri; Jace takes control of Nahiri's mind and the Core, but Ashaya takes it and hands it to Nissa.
events.quote: he was caught by Ashaya who took the Core and handed it to Nissa herself.

events.summary: Nissa learns the Core is a piece of Zendikar's soul and uses its power against Nahiri's hedrons; the Singing City and part of the forest are flattened.
Zendikar begins healing and Nissa flies home to Bala Ged; Jace finds the Core's power gone.
events.quote: As Jace picked up the Lithoform Core, he found that its power was gone.

relations.quote: Nahiri killed Zareth in the process.

relations.note: Nissa broke off their partnership and opposes Nahiri.
relations.quote: For this, Nissa broke up their partnership.

relations.note: Elemental ally who delivers the Core to her.
relations.quote: had destroyed it with help from Ashaya and her other elementals
Jace turned the the tables on her and took control of her mind.
